parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const reserved=$('Reserve notification effect').first().json;const accepted=Array.isArray(r.accepted)?r.accepted.map(e=>String(e).toLowerCase()):[];const required=[reserved.recipient_email,reserved.cc_email].filter(Boolean).map(e=>String(e).toLowerCase());if(!required.length||!required.every(e=>accepted.includes(e))||(r.rejected||[]).length||typeof r.messageId!=='string'||!r.messageId||r.messageId.length>200)throw Error('SMTP acceptance not verified');const e=$('Validate case event').first().json;return [{json:{operation:'finish',event_id:e.event_id,lease_token:e.lease_token,receipt:r.messageId}}];
if($input.first().json.done!==true)throw Error('Ambiguous notification requires manual reconciliation');return [{json:{event_id:$('Validate case event').first().json.event_id,completed:true}}];
